senses.sense_definition: A period of one hundred consecutive years.

examples.text: We are currently living in the twenty-first <w>century</w>.

target_lang_translations.ru: Мы сейчас живем в двадцать первом <w>веке</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 我们目前生活在二十一<w>世纪</w>。

examples.text: The old castle has stood on the hill for more than a <w>century</w>.

target_lang_translations.ru: Старый замок стоит на холме уже более <w>века</w>.
target_lang_translations.nl: Het oude kasteel staat al meer dan een <w>eeuw</w> op de heuvel.

target_lang_translations.cs: Starý hrad stojí na kopci již více než <w>století</w>.
target_lang_translations.tr: Eski kale, tepede bir <w>asırdan</w> fazla bir süredir ayakta duruyor.
target_lang_translations.es: El viejo castillo ha estado en la colina durante más de un <w>siglo</w>.
target_lang_translations.zh: 这座古老的城堡在山头上已经矗立了超过一个<w>世纪</w>。

senses.sense_definition: A score of one hundred runs or points in sports such as cricket or snooker.

examples.text: The batsman raised his bat to the crowd after scoring a <w>century</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A unit in the ancient Roman army, originally consisting of one hundred soldiers.

examples.text: The centurion was responsible for the discipline of his <w>century</w>.
